title: vl04: the vector in the definition of the ket is written without decoration (a number by the lecture's own notation convention)

legacy.old_text: der lineare Operator $z\mapsto z\Psi$ zu interpretieren, wobei $\Psi\in \mathcal{H}$
is to be interpreted as the linear operator $z\mapsto z\Psi$

reason: The Merksatz of the same lecture (vl04.tex:32) says that a symbol without decoration is a number. Psi in z -> z Psi is a vector, so it needs a mark; the course writes it with the bold vector macro to tell it from the ket-as-map (c03.eq.ket-op). Notation consistency, not a mathematical error.
